/*===================================BACKUP===================================*/
CREATE TABLE D360.EDS_ATM_CLIENT_BU_20250114
WITH 
(
	DISTRIBUTION = HASH([CLT_CIF_NUMBER]),
	HEAP
) AS
SELECT * FROM EDS.ATM_CLIENT

/*==================================PATCH SCRIPT===================================*/
select a.CLT_ID, A.BNK_CODE,a.SCD_START_DATE,a.SCD_END_DATE pre_patch, case when b.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' then b.SCD_END_DATE else  c.previous_business_day end post_patch,a.file_name from EDS.ATM_CLIENT a
inner join (
            select CLT_ID,BNK_CODE,SCD_START_DATE,
            LEAD(SCD_START_DATE, 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY CLT_ID,BNK_CODE  ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) as SCD_END_DATE
            from EDS.ATM_CLIENT where clt_id = '11111') b
            on a.CLT_ID = b.CLT_ID and a.SCD_START_DATE = b.SCD_START_DATE and a.BNK_CODE = b.BNK_CODE
left join eds.date_dim c on b.SCD_end_date = c.fulldate

update a 
set a.scd_end_date = case when b.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' then b.SCD_END_DATE else  c.previous_business_day  end 
, a.islatest =  case when b.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' then 1 else  0  end 
from EDS.ATM_CLIENT a
inner join (
            select CLT_ID,BNK_CODE,SCD_START_DATE,
            LEAD(SCD_START_DATE, 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY CLT_ID,BNK_CODE  ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) as SCD_END_DATE
            from EDS.ATM_CLIENT where CLT_ID = '11111'  ) b
            on a.CLT_ID = b.CLT_ID and a.SCD_START_DATE = b.SCD_START_DATE and a.BNK_CODE = b.BNK_CODE
left join eds.date_dim c on b.SCD_end_date = c.fulldate


/*==================================PROD PATCH SCRIPT===================================*/
update a 
set a.scd_end_date = case when b.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' then b.SCD_END_DATE else  c.previous_business_day  end 
, a.islatest =  case when b.SCD_END_DATE = '9999-12-31' then 1 else  0  end 
from EDS.ATM_CLIENT a
inner join (
            select CLT_ID,BNK_CODE,SCD_START_DATE,
            LEAD(SCD_START_DATE, 1 ,'9999-12-31') OVER (PARTITION BY CLT_ID,BNK_CODE  ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) as SCD_END_DATE
            from EDS.ATM_CLIENT where clt_id in ('125838','1953383','138855') ) b
            on a.CLT_ID = b.CLT_ID and a.SCD_START_DATE = b.SCD_START_DATE and a.BNK_CODE = b.BNK_CODE
left join eds.date_dim c on b.SCD_end_date = c.fulldate



Update EDS.ATM_CLIENT set SCD_END_DATE = '9998-12-31', islatest = 1 where clt_id = 
SELECT clt_id,scd_start_date,scd_end_date,islatest,* FROM EDS.ATM_CLIENT order by 1,2
